body:
MVC currently skips validation of active union cases because `IUnion.Value` is declared as `object`. Resolve runtime metadata before validation so invalid cases produce automatic HTTP 400 responses under `[ApiController]`.

Preserves property validation attributes, suppression, and validation-state overrides. Adds integration and HTTP regression coverage for nested unions, collections, nullable unions, and custom `IUnion` implementations.

Fixes the reported MVC bug in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/64599#issuecomment-6160610105
Fixes #68268

[release/11.0 backport](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69929)
title: Validate active union cases in MVC
